plugin.name: ACP Agents
plugin.description: Antigravity CLI, CodeBuddy Code, Command Code and Gemini CLI as coding agents.
plugin.longDescription: Adds four coding agents that speak the Agent Client Protocol to Settings → Agents, beside Claude Code and Codex. Install an agent and sign in with its own command, then turn it on in Settings → Agents; OhMyGame reads its models from the agent. Gemini CLI is for Gemini Code Assist plans; other Google accounts use Antigravity CLI.
